controls.title: AWS WAF Protection
controls.description: Web application traffic must be monitored and protected by AWS WAF.
controls.bedrock_prompt: Explain whether the available AWS WAF evidence demonstrates that web application security monitoring and protection are operating.

controls.title: Threat Correlation
controls.description: Security events should be correlated to identify suspicious activity and attack campaigns.
controls.bedrock_prompt: Summarize whether ARMAGEDDON correlated findings demonstrate an operating security detection capability.

controls.title: Incident Response
controls.description: Security incidents should be created, tracked, and managed through the ARMAGEDDON SOAR pipeline.
controls.bedrock_prompt: Explain whether the ARMAGEDDON security incident evidence supports operation of the incident-response process.

controls.title: Executive Security Reporting
controls.description: Security reports should be available to provide leadership with security visibility.
controls.bedrock_prompt: Explain whether ARMAGEDDON executive reporting demonstrates governance and security visibility for leadership.
